findings.message: Set the 'Secure' flag on this cookie.
findings.triage: Confirmed conditional Secure flag: HTTP requests receive a cookie without Secure. Production exposure depends on HTTPS termination and proxy configuration.
findings.recommended_action: Enforce Secure cookies and HTTPS in production; verify trusted reverse-proxy forwarded scheme handling.

findings.message: Use model binding instead of accessing the raw request data
findings.triage: Raw payment payload access supports signature verification. Model-binding normalization could break signature verification; do not mechanically apply this recommendation.
findings.recommended_action: Review the payment-verification contract and retain documented raw-body access if required. Human acceptance/suppression is pending.
